takeaway: Cord layers continue the abdominal wall: external oblique to external spermatic fascia, internal oblique to cremaster and cremasteric fascia, transversalis fascia to internal spermatic fascia, peritoneum to tunica vaginalis.

lines.text: Each layer of the abdominal wall continues around the spermatic cord.
The external oblique aponeurosis becomes the external spermatic fascia.
The internal oblique gives a few muscle fibres and its fascia: the cremaster muscle and cremasteric fascia.
The transversalis fascia, where the processus vaginalis pushes through at the deep ring, becomes the internal spermatic fascia.
And the peritoneum, carried down as the processus vaginalis, forms the tunica vaginalis.
So every pairing is correct: the answer is All of the above.
lines.say: So every pairing is correct (laugh): the answer is all of the above.
